;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Khash-Zahedan suicide bombing]]
**At least 27 [[Iranian Revolutionary Guards Corps|Iranian Revolutionary Guards]] are killed after a suicide bombing attack in southeastern [[Iran]]. The attack is claimed by [[Jaish ul-Adl]] militants. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/13/world/middleeast/iran-bombing.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-guards-attack-claim/jaish-al-adl-militant-group-claims-responsibility-for-attack-against-irans-revolutionary-guards-fars-news-idUSKCN1Q225B (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Israel–Venezuela relations]], [[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**Venezuelan [[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis#Recognition|disputed]] interim President [[Juan Guaidó]] states that he is working to restore ties with [[Israel]], which were broken by [[Hugo Chávez]]'s anti-Israeli policy, while also weighing whether to relocate the nation's embassy into [[Jerusalem]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/venezuela-guaido-working-restore-ties-israel-190213060829530.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War]]
**The Kremlin announces that [[Russia]], [[Iran]] and [[Turkey]] will hold their fourth round of talks in [[Sochi]] on Thursday with regards to their roles in the [[Syrian Civil War]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/russia-iran-turkey-hold-fourth-syria-talks-sochi-190213135429737.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*The [[Public Prosecutor General (Germany)|Public Prosecutor General]] of [[Germany]] announces the arrest of two members of the [[Syria]]n [[Military Intelligence Directorate (Syria)|military intelligence service]] on charges of [[crimes against humanity]]. The arrests happened the day before in the [[States of Germany|states]] of [[Berlin]] and [[Rhineland-Palatinate]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-arrests-two-syrians-for-alleged-crimes-against-humanity/a-47496784 (DW)]
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation|Special Counsel investigation]]
**[[United States federal judge|U.S. District Court Judge]] [[Amy Berman Jackson]] rules that political consultant and former Trump campaign chairman [[Paul Manafort]]  breached his plea deal with special counsel [[Robert Mueller]] by  intentionally lying, about three of five matters, to investigators and the federal grand jury. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47234491 (BBC News)] [https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-6702605/Judge-finds-Manafort-lied-investigators-Russia-probe.html (''Daily Mail'')]
;Politics and elections
*[[List of Trump administration dismissals and resignations|Trump administration dismissals and resignations]]
**[[FEMA]] Administrator [[Brock Long]] announces his resignation. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/fema-administrator-brock-long-announces-resignation (Fox News)]
;Science and technology

*[[Exploration of Mars]]
**The mission of [[NASA]]'s ''[[Opportunity (rover)|Opportunity]]'' rover on [[Mars]] comes to an end. The rover stopped communicating in June 2018 after a Martian dust storm, and attempts to reestablish communications have not been successful. [https://www.nasa.gov/press-release/nasas-record-setting-opportunity-rover-mission-on-mars-comes-to-end (NASA)]
